author: toketrain
body:
Offender: Polar_Express

Offenses:
Rudeness
Flame war starting
Encouraging spam


Polar has been rude on the forums to me, starting with saying that I can't have an opinion not being a donor and just recently calling me a b****, very rude. He deleted the comment calling me this, but I took a picture of it. After this, I genuinely tried to be nice to him. He refused to apologize, and instead kept on being rude. He's told me I cannot truly support Avicus because I can't donate. He's said I can't give him feedback because I am not a map maker, truly biased of course because he allows feedback as long as he likes it. He has been rude in game- of course I don't have proof for this, but it's true. He thinks he is above everyone else because he has donated and has pretty much said that, too. He thinks that people who can't afford what he can, can't truly support the server. He encourages spam topics, has spammed the forums/staff himself demanding more walls maps, and has made very flame-war-starting comments on threads, which have successfully started flame wars and leading to the thread being locked, clearly breaking rule #1 in catagory E. of the forum rules. He makes unnecessary comments that bump his maps sometimes and potentially flamey comments. 
You can go here and look through to past pages. Every once in a while you'll see comments that are spammy, unnecessary, or flamey.

Basically, I'm kind of surprised he hasn't been punished with all of this adding up, and finally the cussing directed towards me.
If this isn't enough to get him at least temporarily forum banned, I don't know what is. If you feel that his donations and the fact that he has submitted many maps, most of which have gotten accepted, are good enough reasons to hold off on punishment, I don't know what to say.
